name: Step 1 — UPRO Only (4-State)
description: 4-state machine using only UPRO (3x S&P 500). States: BULL_100 (99% UPRO), BULL_TRIMMED (75% UPRO, RSI-triggered), DEFENSIVE (50% UPRO, SMA breach), CASH (kill switch). Signal source: SPY SMA-50/200, RSI-14, VIX.
data_period: 2019-2026 (live data); Full History toggle available back to 2011

vixThreshold.label: VIX Kill Switch
vixThreshold.tier_note: Ravi's fear-gauge threshold (VIX>30 = get defensive). Locked in the headline optimization pass.

smaKill.label: SMA Period (Kill)
smaKill.tier_note: Ravi's 200-day trend line. Locked in the headline optimization pass. Wired into the Python engine 2026-09-24 -- previously this slider was silently ignored server-side.

smaDef.label: SMA Period (Defense)
smaDef.tier_note: Ravi's 50-day trend line. Locked in the headline optimization pass. Wired into the Python engine 2026-09-24 -- previously this slider was silently ignored server-side.

confirmDays.label: Confirm Days
confirmDays.tier_note: Held fixed at 2, never optimized, as of 2026-09-24 -- same reasoning as Step 2's identical param (see strategies/step2_upro_tqqq_6state.json): freeing this let an optimizer push it high enough to quietly disable the defensive-trim rule rather than genuinely tune it (real SPY streaks below/above the 50-day average almost never sustain double-digit day counts), and it only looked good because 2011-2021 happened to reward staying invested.

reentryImmunityDays.label: Fresh Position Grace Period
reentryImmunityDays.tier_note: Ravi's own number, confirmed directly with the client (WhatsApp, 2026-05-24) -- the single most-discussed refinement across the whole engagement, called 'blanketing' or 'defensive confirm days' in the original meetings. After a fresh full re-entry, the fast 50-day trim rule is switched off for this many days, so it can't immediately chop a brand-new position back down before the 50-day average catches up to the 200-day one. Fixes the exact 'buy high, sell low' pattern Ravi called out directly in the trade logs (raised in meetings 3, 4, and 5). Measured effect when this was built: CAGR improved from ~20.3% to 23% (Step 1) and ~20.4% to 22.6% (Step 2) versus no grace period. Applies only to the 50-day defensive trim -- the VIX/200-day kill switch is deliberately never affected by this and always fires immediately (see Section 4/9 of the whipsaw investigation for why that asymmetry itself became a separate finding).

rsiPeriod.label: RSI Period
rsiPeriod.tier_note: Ravi named the overbought/rebuy levels (75/60), not the lookback window. Fair game for optimization. Wired into the Python engine 2026-09-24 -- previously this slider was silently ignored server-side.

rsiOB.label: RSI Overbought (Trim)
rsiOB.tier_note: Ravi's overheat/trim level. Locked in the headline optimization pass.

rsiRe.label: RSI Rebuy Level
rsiRe.tier_note: Ravi's rebuy level. Locked in the headline optimization pass.

uproSplit.label: UPRO Allocation
uproSplit.tier_note: Never specified by Ravi -- an implementation choice. Fair game for optimization. Wired into the Python engine 2026-09-24 -- previously this slider was silently ignored server-side.

capital.label: Initial Capital
capital.tier_note: Account size, not a strategy setting. Never optimized.
